title: 設定視窗可自由跨螢幕移動
summary: 移除拖曳設定視窗時的單一螢幕邊界限制，允許跨螢幕擺放；只有標題列無法操作時才協助移回。
highlights: 拖曳途中與放開後不再強制把視窗拉回單一螢幕。
重新顯示或螢幕配置改變時，只在標題列無法操作的情況下做最小幅度移回。
usage: 更新後直接拖曳設定或編輯視窗的標題列即可，不需額外設定。

en.title: Move settings windows freely across displays
en.summary: Settings windows can span displays without being forced back onto one screen. Recovery moves them only when the title bar is no longer reachable.
highlights: Windows are no longer forced back onto a single display during or after dragging.
When a window reappears or the display layout changes, it moves only as far as needed to restore access to its title bar.
en.usage: After updating, drag the title bar of a settings or editor window as usual. No additional setup is required.
